security.title: Security center
security.devProblems: Development mode: {count} production checks failed (warnings only)
security.devProblemsDesc: In production mode (prod) these would stop the service from starting. Follow the fix for each item in your local .env or environment variables.
security.previewProblems: Production preview: the service would refuse to start, {count} checks failed
security.previewProblemsDesc: The startup log lists the failed checks. Until they are fixed, the service cannot start with prod.
security.allPassedDesc: These checks would not block startup in production either.
security.productionMode: Running in production mode: all checks passed
security.notChecked: No service has run the startup self-check
security.trustedProxiesDesc: X-Forwarded-For is honored only for requests from these ranges. If clients can reach the gateway directly, narrow it to the actual reverse proxy and gateway addresses.
security.redisAllowlistDesc: Rejected {count} times since startup · extra prefixes: {prefixes}
security.footnote: The security center is read-only; checks cannot be turned off here. To skip a check, set tuoyu.selfcheck.skip (for example P4); the startup log records it.
